descriptions.categories_list: Fetch the full Woolworths department tree with product counts. Takes no parameters and needs no account. Returns an array of nodes carrying NodeId, Description and ProductCount, covering both the ordinary departments and the specials groups. Six specials groups hold catalogue products - specialsgroup.3676 (Half Price), 3673 (Everyday Low Price), 3668 (Buy More Save More), 3694 (Lower Shelf Price), 3721 (Seasonal Price) and 3704 (Bundles); specialsgroup.-2, .everydaymarket and .onlineonly exist but report zero products. Call this first to obtain the node id that categories_browse and specials-diff require.
descriptions.settings_bootstrap: Fetch the single startup payload the Woolworths web app requests on page load. Takes no parameters and needs no account. Returns one object bundling ConfigRequest (site configuration and the current site build version), ShopperRequest (shopper and session state), TrolleyRequest (a trolley summary), ListTopLevelPiesCategories (the top-level department list), GetDeliveryInfoRequest and LatestFulfilledInvoiceRequest. Prefer this over several separate calls when you want session, trolley and category context in one round trip; use settings_list instead for the full flat feature-flag table.
descriptions.settings_list: List every site setting and feature flag Woolworths exposes to its web front end. Takes no parameters and needs no account. Returns a flat array of roughly 1,700 {Group, Name, Value} entries, for example Group "OneSite", Name "LargeFormatPageSize", Value 36. Use it to discover server-side limits and toggles - maximum page size, which features are enabled - before tuning other calls; use settings_bootstrap instead for the per-session startup payload.
descriptions.trolley_get: Read the current trolley, including the anonymous guest cart, with no account required. Takes no parameters. Returns the trolley object: AvailableItems and UnavailableItems, TrolleyItemCount and TotalTrolleyItemQuantity, Totals and DeliveryFee, plus the restriction and conflict lists (RestrictedItems, ConflictedItems, ExceededSupplyLimitGroups, ExceededAtpLimitItems) that explain why a line cannot be fulfilled. Call it after trolley_add to confirm what actually landed in the cart and what it now costs.
